# QR Code generator

`qrcodegen.js` is the unmodified ES6 release v1.8.0 from Project Nayuki.
Source: https://github.com/nayuki/QR-Code-generator/releases/tag/v1.8.0
License: MIT, included in the file header.
SHA-256: `6a1116192ed1dd67fa1bf31e77f5817103d71c23bbac24c382e698b7668bdd01`.

Served from Seismik's own origin. It generates the authenticator QR in memory;
no remote image service, CDN, telemetry, or persistence receives the MFA URI.
